overview_description.description: Rudus provides an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform tailored for concrete subcontractors. The platform ingests structural blueprints, detects elements such as slabs, footings, columns, and walls, and converts them into structured quantities. It applies computer vision and multi-sheet reasoning to organize mixed drawing sets, resolve measurements, and expand rebar assemblies. Rudus supports natural language queries so estimators can search plans and specifications directly within the application. Teams can collaborate on plan sets from any browser and keep edits synchronized. The software exports quantities and cost items into existing estimating and bidding tools for downstream pricing workflows. Rudus focuses on trade-specific depth for concrete estimation to help subcontractors manage more bids within the same workflow environment.
